best-phone-cleaner-app-android::sec.what: What to look for in a phone cleaner

Storage fills up for five reasons. A good cleaner targets each one.

  • Big videos: a few files can outweigh thousands of small ones.
  • Duplicates: the same file saved twice.
  • Near-identical shots: bursts and retakes.
  • Screenshots: years of them.
  • Trash and app cache: leftovers that still take space.

Add compression, on-device privacy and a confirmation before anything is deleted.

phone-charging-port-cleaner::title: Phone Charging Port Cleaner: Safe Steps
phone-charging-port-cleaner::meta_descri: CleanKoach is a software cleaner and cannot clean a charging port. Here is how to clean one safely: power off, remove debris gently and keep liquids out.
phone-charging-port-cleaner::tagline: CleanKoach cleans storage, not ports. Here is the safe way
phone-charging-port-cleaner::quick_answe: An app cannot clean a charging port, and CleanKoach does not try. CleanKoach clears storage. To clean the port, turn the phone off, unplug everything, tap loose debris out with the port facing down, never push anything in and keep liquids away. If it still will not charge, ask a repair shop.
phone-charging-port-cleaner::intro: A phone that charges slowly or not at all is often blocked by pocket lint. That is a physical problem, so software cannot fix it. These steps are cautious by design.
phone-charging-port-cleaner::sec.softwar: What software can and cannot do

CleanKoach frees storage space. It cannot touch the hardware, so it cannot clear lint from a charging port, and any app that claims to is not telling the truth. Use a cleaner app for storage and the steps below for the port.
Best phone cleaner app for Android
phone-charging-port-cleaner::sec.signs.h:
• The cable has to be held at an angle to charge.
  • Charging is slow or keeps stopping.
  • The cable feels loose in the port.
  • Your phone shows a liquid or debris warning.
phone-charging-port-cleaner::sec.steps.h:
1. Turn the phone off and unplug the charger, cable and any headphones.
  2. Look into the port with a torch. Lint packed at the bottom is the usual cause.
  3. Tap out loose debris. Hold the port facing down and gently tap the phone against your hand.
  4. If the port is wet, leave the phone off on a flat surface to dry at room temperature.
  5. Try a different cable. A worn cable can look like a port fault.
phone-charging-port-cleaner::sec.avoid.h:
• Metal tools: pins and needles can scratch the contacts or short them.
  • Liquids: keep water, soap and cleaning products out of openings.
  • Compressed air: both Apple and Google advise against it, so do not use it.
  • Charging while wet: wait until the port is dry.

Apple and Google both say to keep moisture out of openings.
phone-charging-port-cleaner::sec.help.ht: If the port looks burned, melted or corroded, the warning lasts two hours or more, or the phone is too hot to touch, stop charging and contact the maker or a repair shop. A loose or damaged port needs a repair, not more cleaning.
phone-charging-port-cleaner::sec.message: If you see a liquid or debris warning

Some phones warn you when they detect moisture or debris in the port. On a Pixel, unplug everything, let the phone cool, dry the port and wait a few minutes for the all-clear message. Other makers have similar steps in their support pages.
phone-charging-port-cleaner::sec.care.ht: Carry the phone in a pocket without loose fabric and cover the port with a plug if your case has one. Check the port when charging slows down, not after it stops.
phone-charging-port-cleaner::faq.0.q: Can an app clean my phone's charging port?
phone-charging-port-cleaner::faq.0.a: No. A charging port is hardware. CleanKoach clears storage and cannot clean ports.
phone-charging-port-cleaner::faq.1.q: How do I clean a charging port safely?
phone-charging-port-cleaner::faq.1.a: Turn the phone off, unplug everything, tap loose debris out with the port facing down, and keep liquids and metal tools away.
phone-charging-port-cleaner::faq.2.q: Can I use a toothpick or a pin?
phone-charging-port-cleaner::faq.2.a: Avoid anything you push into the port, and never use metal. Google's guidance says not to insert anything into the port.
phone-charging-port-cleaner::faq.3.q: Is compressed air safe for a charging port?
phone-charging-port-cleaner::faq.3.a: Apple says not to use it on iPhone and Google advises against it on Pixel, so do not use it.
phone-charging-port-cleaner::faq.4.q: What if my phone says there is liquid or debris in the port?
phone-charging-port-cleaner::faq.4.a: Unplug everything, let it cool, dry the port and wait for the all-clear message. If the warning lasts two hours or more, contact the maker.
phone-charging-port-cleaner::faq.5.q: Why is my phone charging slowly?
phone-charging-port-cleaner::faq.5.a: A blocked port, a worn cable or a weak charger. Try another cable and charger first, then check the port.
phone-charging-port-cleaner::faq.6.q: Should I charge a wet phone?
phone-charging-port-cleaner::faq.6.a: No. Let the port dry first.
phone-charging-port-cleaner::faq.7.q: When should I take it to a repair shop?
phone-charging-port-cleaner::faq.7.a: If the port is burned, melted, corroded, loose, or the phone gets too hot to touch.
phone-charging-port-cleaner::faq.8.a: No. CleanKoach frees storage and does not change how your phone charges.

To free up space on an iPhone, use the tools built into iOS: check Settings, General, iPhone Storage, follow its recommendations, offload apps you rarely use and turn on Optimize iPhone Storage if you use iCloud Photos.

phone-cleaner-iphone::sec.check.h2: Check what is using your iPhone storage
phone-cleaner-iphone::sec.check.html:
1. Open Settings, then General.
  2. Tap iPhone Storage. You see recommendations and a list of apps with the space each uses.
  3. Tap an app's name for details.

Apple notes that cached and temporary data might not count as usage in this list.
phone-cleaner-iphone::sec.recommendation: If storage is full, tap Show All in the Storage section to see recommendations. Tap Enable to turn one on, or tap it to review what you can delete. On iOS 17 and later, the Recommended for You list in Apple's photo storage steps can flag photos, large files or backups that you might not need.
phone-cleaner-iphone::sec.apps.html: Open an app's entry in iPhone Storage and choose to offload it. That frees the space the app takes up and keeps its documents and data. Deleting the app removes its related data as well.
phone-cleaner-iphone::sec.photos.html: Photos and videos are usually the biggest item. If you use iCloud Photos, turn on Optimize iPhone Storage: full-resolution originals stay in iCloud and smaller copies stay on the phone when space is needed. Apple also suggests merging duplicate photos and videos. This depends on having enough iCloud storage.

phone-screen-cleaner::meta_description: CleanKoach cannot clean a phone screen, because it clears storage. Here is how to clean a screen safely with a soft cloth, and what to avoid so it is not scratched.

phone-screen-cleaner::quick_answer: No app cleans a phone screen, and CleanKoach does not claim to. To clean the glass, turn the phone off, unplug it, wipe with a soft, lint-free cloth, use a slightly damp one for grime, never spray liquid directly on the phone and keep moisture out of the openings.
phone-screen-cleaner::intro: A smeared screen is the easiest phone problem to fix, and the easiest to make worse. Both Apple and Google give the same core advice.
phone-screen-cleaner::sec.software.h2: Why an app cannot do this
phone-screen-cleaner::sec.software.html: A screen collects oil and dust on the glass. CleanKoach works on files and storage, so it has no effect on the glass. Use it for storage and a cloth for the screen.
phone-screen-cleaner::sec.software.see.0: Best phone cleaner app for Android
phone-screen-cleaner::sec.basic.html:
1. Turn the phone off and unplug all cables.
  2. Wipe with a soft, lint-free cloth. A dry microfibre cloth removes dust, smudges and streaks.
  3. For grime, use a slightly damp cloth, or a screen wipe or glasses cleaner on Pixel.
  4. Wipe gently. Avoid excessive rubbing.
  5. Let it dry before you turn it on.

Apple says you may use a 70% isopropyl alcohol wipe, a 75% ethyl alcohol wipe or Clorox Disinfecting Wipes on the outside of an iPhone, then wipe with a soft, slightly damp, lint-free cloth. Google says household disinfecting wipes or 70% isopropyl alcohol wipes can be used on a Pixel, including on the screen. Wipes, not liquid: do not pour or spray anything onto the phone.
phone-screen-cleaner::sec.avoid.html:

  • Spraying directly: do not spray cleaner onto the phone.
  • Moisture in openings: keep it out of the ports and speakers.
  • Abrasive materials: Apple says cleaning products and abrasives can diminish the oil-repellent coating and might scratch the screen.
  • Soaking: do not submerge the phone in any cleaning agent.

phone-speaker-cleaner::quick_answer: No app can clean a phone speaker, and CleanKoach does not claim to. A muffled speaker is usually blocked by dust or lint. Turn the phone off, wipe the grille with a dry soft cloth, use a soft dry brush gently, keep moisture out of the openings and avoid compressed air.
phone-speaker-cleaner::intro: If calls sound faint or music is muffled, first rule out a software cause, then look at the speaker grille. Here is a cautious order of steps.

Best phone cleaner app for Android
phone-speaker-cleaner::sec.rule-out.h2: Rule out the easy causes first
phone-speaker-cleaner::sec.rule-out.html:
1. Check volume and mode. Silent mode, a low volume slider or Do Not Disturb can look like a fault.
  2. Check Bluetooth. Audio may be going to an earbud or speaker you forgot.
  3. Remove the case. Some cases cover or partly block the speaker.

phone-speaker-cleaner::sec.clean.html:

  5. Test the sound with a song or a call.

phone-storage-cleaner::title: Phone Storage Cleaner: How It Works
phone-storage-cleaner::h1: How a phone storage cleaner works
phone-storage-cleaner::meta_description: A phone storage cleaner finds what fills your Android storage and helps you clear it safely. See how CleanKoach scans, what it removes and what it never touches.
phone-storage-cleaner::tagline: What a storage cleaner scans, and what it leaves alone
phone-storage-cleaner::quick_answer: A phone storage cleaner lists what is filling your storage so you can remove it. CleanKoach reads your photo, video and audio library on the phone, shows your largest files, finds identical duplicates and near-identical photos, gathers screenshots and clears trash. You choose what goes, and nothing is uploaded.
phone-storage-cleaner::intro: Storage fills slowly and then all at once. A cleaner does the searching for you. This guide explains what CleanKoach looks at, how it decides, and where its limits are.
phone-storage-cleaner::sec.where-space-g:
• Big files: a handful of videos can outweigh thousands of photos.
  • Exact duplicates: the same file saved twice, often by a chat app or a backup.
  • Near-identical photos: bursts and repeated takes.
  • Screenshots: years of them.
  • Trash: deleted media that has not been emptied yet.
  • Cache: temporary files that apps keep.
  • Apps and their data: managed in Android's own storage settings.
Best phone cleaner app for Android
1. It reads your media library once you allow access to photos, videos and audio. Everything happens on your phone.
  2. Large files are sorted by size, biggest first.
  3. Duplicates are found by comparing file contents with a SHA-256 fingerprint, so two files with different names but identical contents are grouped, and two with the same name but different contents are not.
  4. Similar photos are found by comparing a small fingerprint of how each picture looks. Photos that look almost the same are grouped, and the largest file in each group is suggested as the one to keep. You can pick another.
  5. Screenshots are gathered into one list.

On Android 12 and newer you can optionally allow media management, which lets CleanKoach delete the items you chose without a prompt each time. You can switch that off in Android Settings whenever you like.
phone-storage-cleaner::sec.compress.h2: Compressing frees space only when you delete the original
phone-storage-cleaner::sec.compress.html: Photo optimizer and Video optimizer save a smaller copy to a CleanKoach folder and leave the original where it is. That keeps your memory safe, but the space is only freed once you remove the original yourself. Check the smaller copy first, then delete the original.
phone-storage-cleaner::sec.limits.h2: What a storage cleaner cannot do
phone-storage-cleaner::sec.limits.html:
• It does not remove your apps. Uninstall them in Android Settings.
  • Clean Up clears the trash and CleanKoach's own cache. It does not clear other apps' caches or data.
  • It does not make your phone faster by itself. Free space gives your phone room to work, nothing more.

For apps and their data, use Android's storage settings.
phone-storage-cleaner::sec.routine.html: Review Large files once a month, clear Screenshots after big events, and run Duplicates after a chat app backup. Weekly cleanup reminders are optional and can be switched off in Settings.
phone-storage-cleaner::faq.0.q: What is a phone storage cleaner?
phone-storage-cleaner::faq.0.a: An app that shows what is using your phone's storage and helps you remove it. CleanKoach covers large files, duplicates, similar photos, screenshots and trash.
phone-storage-cleaner::faq.1.a: It compares the contents of files using a SHA-256 fingerprint, so identical files are grouped even when their names differ.
phone-storage-cleaner::faq.2.q: How does it find similar photos?
phone-storage-cleaner::faq.2.a: It compares a small fingerprint of how each photo looks. Photos that look almost the same are grouped and the largest is suggested as the one to keep.
phone-storage-cleaner::faq.3.q: Can I change which similar photo is kept?
phone-storage-cleaner::faq.3.a: Yes. The largest file is only a suggestion. You can pick a different photo to keep in each group.
phone-storage-cleaner::faq.4.q: Does CleanKoach delete files without asking?
phone-storage-cleaner::faq.4.a: No. You choose what to remove, and Android asks you to confirm before media is deleted, unless you allowed the optional media management permission.
phone-storage-cleaner::faq.5.a: An optional Android 12 and newer permission that lets CleanKoach delete the items you chose without asking each time. You can switch it off in Android Settings.
phone-storage-cleaner::faq.6.q: Does Clean Up clear other apps' caches?
phone-storage-cleaner::faq.6.a: No. Clean Up clears trashed photos and videos and CleanKoach's own cache.
phone-storage-cleaner::faq.7.q: Does compressing a photo free space straight away?
phone-storage-cleaner::faq.7.a: Not by itself. The smaller copy is saved next to the original, so space is freed when you delete the original.
phone-storage-cleaner::faq.8.q: Does a storage cleaner speed up my phone?
phone-storage-cleaner::faq.8.a: Not directly. It frees space. CleanKoach does not claim to boost speed.
phone-storage-cleaner::faq.9.a: No. Files are analysed on your phone. Your media, usage data and scan results are never uploaded.

stop-phone-cleaner-popping-up::title: How to Stop a Phone Cleaner Popping Up
stop-phone-cleaner-popping-up::h1: How to stop a phone cleaner popping up
stop-phone-cleaner-popping-up::meta_desc: Phone cleaner pop-ups on Android usually come from website notifications or an app. Find the source, switch it off and stop it coming back, step by step.
stop-phone-cleaner-popping-up::tagline: Find the source, then switch it off
stop-phone-cleaner-popping-up::quick_ans: To stop a phone cleaner popping up, find out what is showing it, then switch that off. The cause is usually a website with notifications allowed, an app with permission to show over other apps, or a cleaner app's own alerts. Long-press the pop-up to see which app sent it, then block or uninstall it.
stop-phone-cleaner-popping-up::intro: A pop-up that says your phone needs cleaning is not always from a cleaner you installed. Work through the sources below, from most to least likely.
stop-phone-cleaner-popping-up::sec.cause:
• A website: you allowed notifications from a site in your browser, and it now sends alerts.
  • An app's notifications: an installed app sends alerts that look like system warnings.
  • An app showing over others: an app with permission to display over other apps.
  • A page inside your browser: a fake alert on a web page, which closes when you close the tab.
Find out which app or site it is

1. Long-press the notification. Android shows the app or site name.
  2. Check where it appears. In the notification shade it is a notification. Over another app it is an overlay. Inside a web page it is the site.
  3. Note the name, then use the table below.

stop-phone-cleaner-popping-up::faq.3.q: What is Display over other apps?
stop-phone-cleaner-popping-up::faq.3.a: An Android permission that lets an app draw on top of other apps. Turn it off for any app that does not need it.
stop-phone-cleaner-popping-up::faq.4.q: Is a pop-up saying my phone has a virus real?
stop-phone-cleaner-popping-up::faq.4.a: Almost never when it comes from a web page or an unknown app. Close the tab and do not tap it. Run a Play Protect scan if you are unsure.
